# vaultwarden_organization_collection (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a collection of an organization by ID or name. The provider user must be a confirmed owner or admin of the organization, or a manager with access to all collections, because collection names are encrypted with the organization key.

Requires `email` and `master_password` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a collection by name. The lookup fails when several collections have the name
data "vaultwarden_organization_collection" "by_name" {
  organization_id = "53878c48-51e9-416d-b31a-1b4209c93832"
  name            = "Engineering"
}

# Or by ID
data "vaultwarden_organization_collection" "by_id" {
  organization_id = "53878c48-51e9-416d-b31a-1b4209c93832"
  id              = "c3c1d2c5-2f5e-4bb4-9e4b-0e3f3c6f5d52"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the collection to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set
- `name` (String) The name of the collection to look up, compared exactly. Collection names are not unique: when several collections have the name, the lookup fails and lists their IDs. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set

### Read-Only

- `external_id` (String) The external ID of the collection, `null` when not set
